title: 历史叙事
visual: period-authentic architecture, clothing, tools, weather, and practical light; no modern objects
performance: restrained status-aware behavior, deliberate decisions, readable reactions before declarations
camera: establish geography and power relations before closeups; use inserts for maps, seals, weapons, or letters
audio: native period ambience, cloth, fire, horses, crowds, and restrained score
avoid: modern gestures, generic throne-room speeches, every shot as frontal dialogue, heroic poses at each cut
